name: office-space
title: Office Space
description: Your coding agents and dev servers from Raycast: see who needs you, message agents, run recipes, send pages, text and files to an agent, and start agents from issues.
author: kocheck

commands.name: agents
commands.title: Agents
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Every agent session: status, project, branch and cost. Message, open, resume, interrupt or stop them.

commands.name: needs-you
commands.title: Needs You
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Go through every agent waiting on you: see the question and recent output, then reply, approve, open or skip.

commands.name: message-agent
commands.title: Message Agent
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Type a message into an agent Office Space hosts.

commands.name: run-recipe
commands.title: Run Recipe
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Start an agent from a recipe: repo, worktree, pinned servers, brief and first message.

commands.name: servers
commands.title: Dev Servers
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Dev servers listening on this Mac and pinned servers: open, stop, restart, logs.

commands.name: skills
commands.title: Skills
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Search the skills library and choose where each skill is synced.

commands.name: digest
commands.title: Today's Agent Digest
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: What each agent worked on today, what it logged, and its token use.

commands.name: send-page
commands.title: Send Page to Agent
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Send the browser's current page (with its content as Markdown) and a note to the agent working on it.

commands.name: send-selection
commands.title: Send Selection to Agent
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Send the text selected in any app to an agent, with a note.

commands.name: send-clipboard
commands.title: Send Clipboard to Agent
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Send what's on the clipboard to an agent, with a note.

commands.name: send-files
commands.title: Send Finder Selection to Agent
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Attach the files selected in Finder (screenshots, logs, designs) and send them to an agent.

commands.name: start-from-issue
commands.title: Start Agent from Issue or PR
commands.subtitle: Office Space
commands.description: Paste a GitHub issue or PR, or a Linear issue: Office Space picks the repo, makes a worktree branch and hands the agent the issue.

preferences.name: hubPath
preferences.title: hub Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the hub inside OfficeSpace.app.

preferences.name: codeFolders
preferences.title: Code Folders
preferences.description: Where your repos live (comma-separated), for Start Agent from Issue or PR.

preferences.name: linearApiKey
preferences.title: Linear API Key
preferences.description: Optional, to read Linear issues (Linear → Settings → API → Personal API keys).
